title: Agent review workflow setup
notes: Mission: the owner's setup brief (planning/CLAUDE-GITHUB-REVIEW-SETUP.md). Behavioral specification: docs/GITHUB-AGENT-REVIEW-PROTOCOL.md. This tooling change needs focused behavior tests, not a whole-mod validation campaign or a game installation. The live pilot runs in foreground mode: the interactive Claude Opus setup session is the developer, so no second setup writer is launched.

checkpoints.scope: Controller, versioned reviewer/developer schemas, prompts, model/permission configuration and behavior tests (tools/agent_review/).
exit_conditions: Controller enforces candidate identity (H/B/M), explicit model selection with requested/observed provenance, schema/request validation, single-writer lock, idempotent publication, bounded retries, round budget, stop/resume and the transcript-only archive check.
Behavior tests with real temporary Git repositories cover protocol rows WF04-WF10 and WF12; only the model and GitHub boundaries are stubbed.
No path lets a malformed, failed, wrong-model or stale review produce readiness.

checkpoints.scope: Complete setup per the brief: controller plus workflow documentation, permissions, installation, Black Tentacles binding and the setup acceptance report.
exit_conditions: All controller-core conditions still hold for the final candidate.
docs/AGENT-REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md covers architecture, permissions, normal use, recovery, costs/limits and uninstall/disable.
Project-local Claude permissions are narrow and do not disable approvals or sandboxes globally; the reviewer profile is read-only without write-capable connectors.
The Black Tentacles plan preserves the mission as the contract with review after Phases 0-1 and at the complete Phase 4 candidate, and the exact start command is documented.
planning/AGENT-REVIEW-SETUP-ACCEPTANCE.md reports WF01-WF12 honestly, distinguishing real model exchanges from fixture simulations.
